description: Categorical gender field stored as text with 30 non-null records and 4 observed distinct values. The values represent two categories with inconsistent casing: 'Male'/'male' and 'Female'/'FEMALE'.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Standardize deterministic case-only variations affecting 66.7% of records to a single convention: 'male' → 'Male', 'FEMALE' → 'Female'.
